blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) will receive at least P85 million in investments for new leisure, recreation, and tourism developments in northern Luzon across its two estates. Specifically, BCDA’s Clark estate in Pampanga will soon house a resort that Grace Farm Nature Resort Corp. will develop under a 15-year lease agreement. READ: BCDA investments surged 535% to P50B in H1 Additionally, the company has committed to invest at least P50 million in developing, constructing, and improving the resort within the initial lease period.
